headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 22, 2026, the portfolio set has achieved an average return of 18.49%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.30%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 8.19%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 48.48%, contributing a dollar change of $484.76. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 11.52%, highlighting a notable disparity in performance across the portfolio set. Such relative strength against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or macroeconomic uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
